### Continuous ranking and re-ranking

Malachyte continuously ranks and re-ranks content based on real time behavior, rather than nightly batches. As shopper intent is understood throughout the session, recommendations improve, ensuring the most relevant options surface at every moment. Nothing is static. Nothing is stale.

Increasing relevance with every interaction

Fewer dead ends and faster discovery

More efficient conversion paths and higher RPV

![](https://www.malachyte.com/images/product/continuous-ranking-panel.webp)

### Persistent learning compounds ROI over time

Rather than resetting after a session, behavior intelligence continuously learns across all interactions, building long-term understanding that improves over time and across users, seasons, and inventory turns. As engagement compounds, revenue per visitor grows — while CAC stays flat.

Persistent intelligence across sessions (long-term memory)

Improved lifetime value and retention

Network effects that compound performance over time

![](https://www.malachyte.com/images/product/persistent-learning-diagram-wide.webp)
